from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal
from ledgerly import audit
from ledgerly.models import Payment
from ledgerly.adjustments import refund
from ledgerly.errors import BillingError

T0 = datetime(2026,1,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc)
audit.clear()

# partial then full
p = Payment("p1","i1",Decimal("100.00"),status="captured")
refund(p, Decimal("40.00"), T0)
assert p.refunded_amount == Decimal("40.00") and p.status == "captured"
refund(p, Decimal("60.00"), T0)
assert p.refunded_amount == Decimal("100.00") and p.status == "refunded"

# over-refund
p2 = Payment("p2","i1",Decimal("100.00"),status="captured")
try:
    refund(p2, Decimal("101.00"), T0); assert False
except BillingError as e: assert e.code == "refund_exceeds_captured"

# not captured
p3 = Payment("p3","i1",Decimal("100.00"),status="authorized")
try:
    refund(p3, Decimal("10.00"), T0); assert False
except BillingError as e: assert e.code == "invalid_state"

# approval
p4 = Payment("p4","i1",Decimal("1000.00"),status="captured")
try:
    refund(p4, Decimal("500.01"), T0); assert False
except BillingError as e: assert e.code == "approval_required"
refund(p4, Decimal("500.00"), T0)  # at threshold ok
refund(p4, Decimal("500.01"), T0, approved_by="mgr")

# idempotency: retry returns same record, no double refund
p5 = Payment("p5","i1",Decimal("100.00"),status="captured")
r1 = refund(p5, Decimal("30.00"), T0, idempotency_key="k1")
r2 = refund(p5, Decimal("30.00"), T0, idempotency_key="k1")

assert p6.status == "refunded"
assert refund(p6, Decimal("100.00"), T0, idempotency_key="k2") is p6
assert audit.events("payment_refunded")[-1]["idempotency_key"] == "k2"
print("all edge cases passed")

from ledgerly.errors import BillingError

T0 = datetime(2026,1,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc)
audit.clear()

# partial then full
p = Payment("p1","i1",Decimal("100.00"),status="captured")
refund(p, Decimal("40.00"), T0)

refund(p, Decimal("60.00"), T0)
assert p.refunded_amount == Decimal("100.00") and p.status == "refunded"

# over-refund
p2 = Payment("p2","i1",Decimal("100.00"),status="captured")
try:
    refund(p2, Decimal("101.00"), T0); assert False

p3 = Payment("p3","i1",Decimal("100.00"),status="authorized")
try:
    refund(p3, Decimal("10.00"), T0); assert False
except BillingError as e: assert e.code == "invalid_state"

p4 = Payment("p4","i1",Decimal("1000.00"),status="captured")
try:
    refund(p4, Decimal("500.01"), T0); assert False
except BillingError as e: assert e.code == "approval_required"
refund(p4, Decimal("500.00"), T0)  # at threshold ok
refund(p4, Decimal("500.01"), T0, approved_by="mgr")

# idempotency: retry returns same record, no double refund
p5 = Payment("p5","i1",Decimal("100.00"),status="captured")
r1 = refund(p5, Decimal("30.00"), T0, idempotency_key="k1")
r2 = refund(p5, Decimal("30.00"), T0, idempotency_key="k1")
assert r1 is r2 is p5 and p5.refunded_amount == Decimal("30.00")
# idempotency checked before state validation
p6 = Payment("p6","i1",Decimal("100.00"),status="captured")
refund(p6, Decimal("100.00"), T0, idempotency_key="k2")
assert p6.status == "refunded"
assert refund(p6, Decimal("100.00"), T0, idempotency_key="k2") is p6
assert audit.events("payment_refunded")[-1]["idempotency_key"] == "k2"
print("all edge cases passed")
EOF
